summary: arXiv:1608.08322 (read abstract): the continuant-increasing operation orders Stern-sequence values. For ES, tuv−u−v=p fixes t=(p+u+v)/(uv) given (u,v), so a move that changes t's residue while keeping p must change u or v; the only p-preserving reordering of (t,u,v) is reversal (t,u,v)↦(v,u,t).

summary: Exact identity: tuv−u−v = −K(u,−t,v), where K(a,b,c)=abc+a+c is the continuant, i.e. a length-3 continuant with alternating sign. arXiv:2501.06512 (abstract) gives continuant generating functions and Binet forms for second-order recurrences; nothing about ES follows beyond the identity.

arXiv:2003.13229 gives a two-for-two Egyptian rewriting; applied to two terms of a 3-term solution it keeps the sum, hence stays a 3-term solution of the same 4/p. It maps solutions to solutions, so it cannot create one for a p with no solution (empty orbit). Only the abstract and §1 were read, so the paper's exact rewriting formula is not checked.
